test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The panel of chairpersons in Lok Sabha consists of how many members?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• There can only be** ten chairpersons** in the** Lok Sabha** in India.
 
• They are primarily used to **fill in for speakers **when they are not there.
 
• However, they are** unable to lead** if the **Speaker and Deputy Speaker offices** are vacant.
 
• The** current members **are Arjun Charan Sethi (BJD), M Thambidurai (AIADMK), K V Thomas (Cong), Anandrao Adsul (SS), Hukm Deo Narayan Yadav, Prahlad Joshi, Hukum Singh and Ramen Deka (all BJP), Ratna De (Nag) (Trinamool) and Konakalla Narayan Rao (TDP).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **lower house of India's bicameral Parliament **is known as the **Lok Sabha**, and the **upper house** is known as the **Rajya Sabha.**
 
• There are **545 total seats** in the** Lok Sabha.**
 
• The **Election Commission** will hold elections to fill **543 of these seats.**
 
• If the President decides that the** Anglo-Indian community** has not been adequately represented, persons from that community are nominated to **fill the remaining two seats.**
